columns.name: 同店增长
columns.formula: toFloat64((sum([同店零售金额])-sum([同店同期零售金额])))/toFloat64(abs(sum([同店同期零售金额])))

columns.name: 折扣目标
columns.formula:
case 
when cast(SUM([吊牌目标]) as Double)=0 then 0
else cast(SUM([预算目标]) as Double)/cast(SUM([吊牌目标]) as Double)
end

columns.name: 同店增长预算目标
columns.formula:
case 
when cast(SUM([同店同期零售金额]) as Double)=0 then 0
else cast(SUM([同店预算目标]) as Double)/cast(SUM([同店同期零售金额]) as Double)-1
end

columns.name: 同店增长差值
columns.formula: [同店零售金额同比]-[同店增长预算目标]

columns.name: 本期转化率
同期转化率
客流数同比
columns.formula:
case 
when cast(SUM([同期客流数]) as Double)=0 then 0
else cast(SUM([本期客流数]) as Double)/cast(SUM([同期客流数]) as Double)-1
end

columns.name: 转化率同比
columns.formula: ([本期转化率]/[同期转化率])-1

with dm_maia_sale_daily_chan as (
select 
    a.sale_dt
	,a.sale_hour
	,a.sale_week
	,a.sale_week_day
	,a.sale_mon
	,a.sale_quarter
	,a.sale_year
	,a.cms_code
	,a.channel_brand_code
	,a.channel_brand
	,a.brand_large_area
	,a.store_code
	,a.store_name
	,a.same_store_type
	,a.same_store_type_desc
	,a.is_valid_store
	,a.is_same_store
	,a.is_valid_retail_amt
	,a.sale_qty
	,a.retail_amt
	,a.tag_amt
	,a.receipt_qty
	,a.singl_piece_qty
	,a.is_same_retail_amt
	,a.is_same_tag_amt
	,a.is_same_sale_qty
	,a.is_same_receipt_qty
	,a.is_same_singl_piece_qty
	,a.mini_program_sale_qty
	,a.mini_program_sale_amt
	,a.mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	,a.origin_sale_qty
	,a.origin_sale_amt
	,a.origin_sale_tag_amt
	,0		     as store_pickup_receipt_qty
	,ym
from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_daily_chan_rt a
union all 
select 
    a.sale_dt
	,a.sale_hour
	,a.sale_week
	,a.sale_week_day
	,a.sale_mon
	,a.sale_quarter
	,a.sale_year
	,a.cms_code
	,a.channel_brand_code
	,a.channel_brand
	,a.brand_large_area
	,a.store_code
	,a.store_name
	,a.same_store_type
	,a.same_store_type_desc
	,a.is_valid_store
	,a.is_same_store
	,a.is_valid_retail_amt
	,a.sale_qty
	,a.retail_amt
	,a.tag_amt
	,a.receipt_qty
	,toUInt32(a.singl_piece_qty) as singl_piece_qty
	,a.is_same_retail_amt
	,a.is_same_tag_amt
	,a.is_same_sale_qty
	,a.is_same_receipt_qty
	,toUInt32(a.is_same_singl_piece_qty) as is_same_singl_piece_qty
	,a.mini_program_sale_qty
	,a.mini_program_sale_amt
	,a.mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	,a.origin_sale_qty
	,a.origin_sale_amt
	,a.origin_sale_tag_amt
	,a.store_pickup_receipt_qty
	,ym
from maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_daily_chan_mi a
